translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.bassin.auto_mode.help: Active the pilotage automatic global de the pool.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.bassin.auto_mode.label: Auto mode global
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.bassin.dly_pid_min.hel: Delay before the PID controllers start once filtration has begun.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.bassin.enabled.help: Enable or disable the automatismes PoolLogic.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.bassin.enabled.label: PoolLogic enabled
Pool water volume, used for the filtration requirement (turnover) and for active-oxygen doses.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.bassin.winter_mode.hel: Force the fonctionnement en mode hiver (anti-gel).
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.dis_kd.he: Derivative gain of the ORP controller.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.dis_ki.he: Integral gain of the ORP controller.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.dis_kp.he: Proportional gain of the ORP controller.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.dis_min_o: Minimum disinfection pump injection time; shorter demands are ignored.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.dis_pump_: PDM slot number bound to the ORP / liquid chlorine pump.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.dis_setpo: Target ORP (redox) value measuring the sanitizer level in the water, shared by every disinfection mode.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.dis_windo: PWM time window applied to the ORP pump.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.dly_elect: Delay before salt chlorination is allowed once filtration has begun.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.dose_ml_1: Weekly liquid active oxygen dose per 10 m3.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.last_dose: Internal day of the last O2 injection performed.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.load_fact: Manual factor applied to the computed O2 dose.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.main_hour: Main scheduled hour for O2 dosing.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.min_filte: Minimum filtration runtime before O2 dosing is allowed.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.pending_m: O2 volume still to be injected after an interruption or a reboot.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.protocol_: Etat persistant of protocole de dosage O2.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.secure_el: Minimum water temperature allowed for salt chlorination.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.split_cou: Number of O2 injections scheduled over the week.
PDM slot number bound to the salt chlorinator.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.temp_comp: Active the compensation de dose O2 par temperature.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.disinfection.weekly_do: O2 volume injected since the start of the week.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.filtration.fenetres.fi: Fill priority of window 1 (1 = filled first).
Start of window 1 in minutes since midnight (e.g. 480 = 08:00).
End of window 1 in minutes since midnight. An end earlier than the start makes the window cross midnight.
Enables filtration window 2 (off-peak template 23:30-07:30, priority to be adjusted).
Fill priority of window 2 (1 = filled first, useful for off-peak hours).
Start of window 2 in minutes since midnight (e.g. 1410 = 23:30).
End of window 2 in minutes since midnight. An end earlier than the start makes the window cross midnight.
Fill priority of window 3 (1 = filled first).
Start of window 3 in minutes since midnight.
End of window 3 in minutes since midnight. An end earlier than the start makes the window cross midnight.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.filtration.fenetres.he: Time ranges where filtration is allowed: the computed daily need is spread across them by priority.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.filtration.filtr_cycle: Adjusts the number of daily water turnovers targeted, as a percentage of the temperature reference curve (100 % = original curve, e.g. 1 turnover/day at 22 °C). Raising it lengthens the recommended filtration time proportionally; the result is still capped by the capacity of the active windows. Range 50 to 200 %.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.filtration.filtr_optim: Computed optimal filtration time (volume × turnovers(T°) ÷ flow rate), in minutes, before the active windows cap it. Automatic plan output.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.filtration.filtr_segme: List of the filtration slots computed for the day, format “HH:MM-HH:MM, …”. Automatic plan output.
number de slot PDM pilote for filtration.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.filtration.filtr_start: Automatically computed start time of the main filtration segment.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.filtration.filtr_stop_: Automatically computed end time of the main filtration segment.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.heater.heater_auto_mod: Enables automatic water temperature regulation through the heater.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.heater.heater_setpoint: Target water temperature for heater regulation.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.heater.heater_slot.hel: PDM slot number bound to the water heater.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_auto_mode.label: Auto mode pH
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_deadband.help: Error below which no dosing is triggered. Prevents injecting on probe noise (±0.02 to 0.05 pH).
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_deadband.label: Deadband
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_dose_factor.help: Fraction of the error targeted per batch (0.5 = correct half of it). A value below 1 guarantees convergence without overshoot despite the recirculation delay.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_dose_max_batch.h: Cap on a single injection. Limits how large a correction can be when the error is high or the gain is mis-calibrated.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_dose_max_day.hel: Daily volumetric safety limit. The counter is the pump's own injected volume for the day and survives a reboot.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_dose_ml_m3.help: Millilitres of corrector per m³ of water to move the pH by 0.1. Typical order of magnitude: 10 mL/m³ for 33 % hydrochloric acid at 100 mg/L total alkalinity. Used as a starting value: the controller then calibrates itself from the measured effect.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_dose_ml_m3.label: Dosing gain (mL/m³)
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_dose_plus.help: When enabled, the pH pump injects pH-plus instead of pH-minus.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_dose_plus.label: pH-plus injection
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_gain_learned.hel: Gain auto-calibrated from previous batches, bounded to ±50 % of the configured gain. 0 = not learned yet. Reset when the reference gain or the pool volume changes.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_gain_samples.hel: Number of batches folded into the learned gain.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_last_dose_ts.hel: End of the last injected batch, used to resume the mixing wait after a reboot.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_mix_wait_min.hel: Wait after a batch before measuring again. 0 = computed automatically from pool volume and filtration flow (one full turnover). A non-zero value acts as a floor.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_no_effect_dph.he: Below this pH change after a batch, the injection is considered to have had no effect.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_no_effect_lots.h: Number of consecutive batches with no measurable correction before raising the “dosing has no effect” alarm (empty tank, punctured tubing, stuck probe).
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_pump_slot.help: PDM slot number bound to the pH pump.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_pump_slot.label: Slot pump pH
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_sample_max_age.h: Maximum age of the pH reading used to decide a batch. Beyond it, dosing is suspended until a fresh reading arrives.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_setpoint.label: Setpoint pH
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_valid_max.help: Above this value the probe is considered suspect and dosing is forbidden (never maximal).
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_valid_max.label: Valid reading: maximum
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_valid_min.help: Below this value the probe is considered suspect and dosing is forbidden (never maximal).
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.ph.ph_valid_min.label: Valid reading: minimum
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.refill.fill_min_on_s.h: Duration minimale de marche de the pump de remplissage.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.refill.fill_slot.help: PDM slot number bound to the refill pump.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.refill.fill_slot.label: Refill slot
Delay before the cleaning robot starts automatically.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.robot.robot_slot.help: PDM slot number bound to the cleaning robot.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.robot.robot_slot.label: Robot slot
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.safety.freeze_hold_t.h: Temperature de maintien for protection hors gel.
Water temperature that switches the automations to winter logic.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.sensors.air_temp_io_id: IO id of the air temperature probe.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.sensors.cover_io_id.he: IO id of the digital input wired to the closed-cover contact.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.sensors.dis_io_id.help: Identifiant IO de the measurement ORP.
IO id of the disinfectant tank low-level digital input.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.sensors.flow_io_id.hel: Identifiant IO de input digitale flowswitch (dDSTction de flow rate).
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.sensors.ph_io_id.help: Identifiant IO de the measurement pH.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.sensors.ph_io_id.label: pH sensor IO
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.sensors.ph_lvl_io_id.h: IO id of the digital input for the pH tank low level.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.sensors.pool_lvl_io_id: IO id of the pool level reading.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.sensors.pressure_io_id: IO id of the pressure sensor.
translations.cfgdocs.poollogic.sensors.wat_temp_io_id: IO id of the water temperature probe.
